name: Hatofuru Camp
source:
Isa got invited to go on a Winter camping trip by Ryuuji, along with Miru and Kaku. They spend a day going to various places and having fun. Though, it seems like Isa had forgotten something important?

[From [url=https://akaruiakiki.itch.io/hatofuru-camp]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
龙司邀请伊莎与米鲁和卡库一起参加冬季露营之旅。他们花一天的时间去不同的地方，玩得很开心。不过，伊莎似乎忘记了一些重要的事情？

[来自[url=https://akaruiakiki.itch.io/hatofuru-camp]itch.io[/url]]
